characterization_methods.key_findings: The 0Cu steel under solid solution treatment has an austenitic matrix lattice parameter a = 0.3687 nm, which is higher than the critical lattice parameter (~0.3670 nm) required for κ-carbide precipitation.
characterization_methods.purpose: Determine the lattice parameter of the austenitic matrix of the 0Cu steel under solid solution treatment.

analytical_models.equation_role: Empirical formula relating C, Al and Mn contents (wt.%) that defines the composition boundary for intragranular κ-carbide precipitation; used to compute the critical Al content for the 0Cu steel.
analytical_models.model_name: Composition boundary formula for intragranular κ-carbide precipitation in Fe-Mn-Al-C steel
analytical_models.model_note: Formula: 0.208(wt.%C) + 0.098(wt.%Al) = 1 - 0.0054(wt.%Mn). Applying it gives a critical Al content of 6.52 wt% for the 0Cu steel; the actual Al content (10 wt%) exceeds this, so κ-carbide has sufficient precipitation ability in this steel.

parameters.name: critical Al content for κ-carbide precipitation in 0Cu steel

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Solution treatment applied to both the 0Cu and 3Cu steels; it is the parent state preceding the subsequent aging treatment (550 °C for 3 h), which is NOT part of this solution-treated sample.

structures.overall_structure: Solution-treated austenitic matrix of the 0Cu steel (Fe-28Mn-10Al-1C); XRD-determined lattice parameter a = 0.3687 nm.

unmapped_findings: The lattice parameter of the austenitic matrix of 0Cu steel under solid solution treatment, determined by XRD, is a = 0.3687 nm.

The critical lattice parameter of the austenitic matrix for κ-carbide precipitation is about a = 0.3670 nm; below this value intragranular κ-carbide cannot precipitate. The 0Cu steel lattice parameter (0.3687 nm) exceeds this critical value, so κ-carbide can precipitate from the 0Cu steel.

The critical Al content for κ-carbide precipitation in the 0Cu steel, calculated from the composition boundary formula 0.208(wt.%C) + 0.098(wt.%Al) = 1 - 0.0054(wt.%Mn), is 6.52 wt%; the Al content in 0Cu steel (nominal 10 wt%) exceeds this.
The nominal composition of the 0Cu steel is Fe-28Mn-10Al-1C austenitic low-density steel (Cu-free variant of Fe-28Mn-10Al-1C-(0,3)Cu; Fe balance).
